activities.name: lk_get_pipeline_parameters
activities.description: Get the parameters to be used in this pipeline

value.value:
@concat('Source to Stage Failure: ',
activity('Source To Stage').error.message,'|',
activity('Source To Stage').output.pipelineName,'|',
activity('Source To Stage').output.pipelineRunId,'|')

@concat('Stage to Raw Failure: ',
activity('Stage to Raw').error.message ,'|',
activity('Stage to Raw').output.pipelineName,'|',
activity('Stage to Raw').output.pipelineRunId,'|')

@concat('Raw to Synapse Failure: ',
activity('Raw to Synapse').error.message ,'|',
activity('Raw to Synapse').output.pipelineName,'|',
activity('Raw to Synapse').output.pipelineRunId,'|')

activities.name: ADF_Log
activities.description: SPU to log the details of the Pipeline run

value.value:
@if(empty(variables('v_error_message')),
concat(activity('Source To Stage').output.pipelineName,';',
activity('Stage to Raw').output.pipelineName,';',
activity('Raw to Synapse').output.pipelineName)
,split(join(variables('v_error_message'),';'),'|' )[1])
